title: Career roadmap · Professor
summary: Build an academic career at the intersection of digital health, clinical AI, health informatics and medical technology through rigorous research, publications, teaching, grants and responsible translation.

facts.Course: Health Technology, Digital Health & AI in Medicine (Ph.D.)
facts.Timeline assumption: The roadmap assumes a 2026-start Ph.D. research pathway. The early years establish methodological and domain depth; the post-Ph.D. years focus on independent research, publications, grants, teaching and supervision. Faculty eligibility is institution- and discipline-specific. In India, medical-college faculty requirements are governed separately by the National Medical Commission, so a Ph.D. alone should not be assumed to qualify someone for an MBBS/MD teaching post. National Medical Commission

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build expertise in health informatics, clinical data, AI/ML, digital-health evaluation, research methods and responsible AI.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Establish an independent research niche such as clinical AI, medical imaging AI, digital therapeutics, health informatics or AI governance.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead a research laboratory, supervise Ph.D. students, win competitive grants and build clinical/technology partnerships.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Lead interdisciplinary research centres, shape health-AI research agendas and connect AI innovation with clinical evidence, policy and education.

rows.text: Health research methods, epidemiology and statistics
Produce a research protocol with hypothesis, population, outcomes and statistical plan
Complete a reproducible health-data analysis with documented code and results
Evaluate a model using appropriate train/test separation and clinically meaningful metrics
Medical imaging, signals or clinical NLP
Complete one reproducible research pipeline for the selected modality
Produce a validation plan covering bias, external validity and predefined endpoints
Complete an AI-governance assessment for a proposed health application
Produce an implementation/evaluation framework with measurable adoption and outcome criteria
Prepare a complete grant proposal with objectives, methods, milestones and budget logic
Maintain a research portfolio with publications, datasets/software where appropriate, collaborations and a defined future research agenda

blocks.text: Health-AI research needs unusually strong attention to ethics, safety, transparency, human oversight and evidence of benefit. WHO explicitly emphasizes these issues for AI used in health and medicine. World Health Organization

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Keep one strong domain identity while tracking foundation models, multimodal AI, medical imaging, federated/privacy-preserving learning, digital biomarkers, wearable data and clinical decision support. Do not treat model accuracy alone as evidence of clinical usefulness; evaluation, safety, equity and implementation should remain part of the research program.

blocks.label: Typical planning ranges are

blocks.text: Ph.D. routes

The long-term target is to become an academic leader whose laboratory produces reliable evidence, not merely high-performing models. Lead multidisciplinary teams involving clinicians, statisticians, computer scientists, health-system researchers and policy experts. Build research programs around clinically meaningful outcomes, external validation, equity, privacy, safety and implementation. WHO's current guidance continues to emphasize governance and ethical oversight as AI becomes more deeply integrated into health research and care. World Health Organization
